metas.name: Bhole Baba Paar Karega
metas.description: Middle-aged Bholanath always seems to get in to trouble for his over-confidence, often leading to be an embarrassment. His son however thinks of him to be a hero. Which reputation will he live up to?

metas.name: Bini Sutoy
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Boudi Canteen
metas.description: Poulami, a school teacher and housewife, dreams of utilising her cooking skills to start her own business. But as she takes a bold step towards building her enterprise, will she find her way to success?

metas.name: Byomkesh Hatyamancha
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Haami 2
metas.description: In the world of Haami, there's no anger, rivalry, talking bad, feeling low; there's only joy uninterrupted. The sequel focuses on reality television shows which often create undue pressure on children.

metas.name: Habji Gabji
metas.description: Ambitious parents Ahana and Aditya, grappling with their erratic working hours, introduce their son Tipu to mobile gaming. Over time, the situation takes a turn as the boy's harmless pastime spirals into a relentless addiction.

metas.name: Hirokgorer Hire
metas.description: An adventurous romantic comedy in which Bonny is opposite Ayoshi and Soham opposite Koushani.

metas.name: Hridpindo
metas.description: A married biology professor goes back to her ex boyfriend who is still in love with her. When a secret is revealed, she cannot decide between listening to her heart and her mind.

metas.name: Kacher Manush
metas.description: Kuntol and Sudarshan meet at the railway track where they have come to commit suicide.

metas.name: Kakababur Protyaborton
metas.description: A famous hotel in Nairobi is about to close. People don't go to that hotel like before. Kakababu and Santu go to the hotel to find out the reason. Based on Jongoler Modhye Ek Hotel.

metas.name: Karnasubarner Guptodhon
metas.description: Sona Da, Abir and Jhinuk come across a riddle that turns their vacation into a dangerous quest for the hidden treasure of King Shashanka, one of the best-kept secrets of Bengal.

metas.name: Kishmish
metas.description: Krishanu ‘Tintin’ Chatterjee (Dev), an aspiring graphic novelist, meets Rohini Sen (Rukmini Maitra), a rich, progressive girl, at a college in the hills and the duo fall in love. They are all set to get married when their parents’ past returns to mess things up.

metas.name: Kolkatar Harry
metas.description: Harinath, a carpool driver and Harry Potter fan, loves storytelling and performing magic tricks. Will true magic make its way into Hari's life and solve his problems when he loses his job?

metas.name: Kothamrito
metas.description: Sanatan is mute. He listens to Sulekha, his wife.

metas.name: Mahishasur Marddini
metas.description: The film has been conceptualized as an apology letter to women from all sections of society, who have faced discrimination as well as have been victimized by both men and women in the patriarchal system.

metas.name: Mini
metas.description: The story aims to throw light on the real essence of friendship where age can’t be a boundary. It’s a refreshing tale of a young and hot fashion designer aunt Titli (Mimi Chakraborty) and her school going mischievous niece Mini (Ayanna Chatterjee).

metas.name: Ogo Bideshini
metas.description: A Bengali boy lives in London with his British girlfriend without his parent's knowledge. But when the parents unexpectedly land in London, a comedy of errors begins.

metas.name: Projapati
metas.description: A retired 65-year-old widower lives alone as his wedding planner son runs a busy business, and he's determined to see his son get married.

metas.name: Raavan
metas.description: The life of a man who is seen fighting against an evil person who does bad deeds.

metas.name: Savings Account
metas.description: An action thriller that centres on a bank robbery and around the events and motivations behind it.

metas.name: Shrimati
metas.description: 'Shrimati' is the story of a middle class, conservative housewife, who falls prey to society's glitz and glamour and in the bargain, loses her own identity. In today's malevolent world, where the outer appearance means everything, this middle-aged lady falls victim to the clichéd problem of overall personality and outward appearance that irks all the minds - from teenagers to adults and beyond. She becomes obsessed and, in the process,, almost loses her mind and identity till the sudden realization that - irrespective of the way people think and the way the world goes - one should never forget the soul that dwells within. For it is not about the length or texture of your hair or how perfect your bumps are, but about the kind of person you are and the number of people who love you solely for your nature. She finally gains confidence and self-respect in her own skin and gets ready to take on the world with new vigor and a new "her".

metas.name: The Eken
metas.description: Hotel franchise conglomerate Debraj Singh murders his partner Bipasha Mitra's stepbrother, Ashoke. Kolkata Police detective Ekendra Sen solves the case in the hill station of Darjeeling.

metas.name: Tirandaj Shabor
metas.description: On March 12 rainy night, Sumit Ghoshal, a taxi driver arrives at a police station with a passenger who has suddenly taken ill. The O.C. inspects the passenger to find him dead. ACP-DD Shabor Dasgupta and Inspector Nanda must solve the case.

metas.name: Toke Chhara Banchbo Na
metas.description: A love story revolves around Arjun & Hiya. A journey of love and belief that has to fight the odds of life and death.

metas.name: Tushagni
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: X = Prem
metas.description: Khilat, a young software engineer, and Joyee are determined to face any and all problems that life throws at them. Will they ever get there happily ever after?

metas.name: 72 Hours
metas.description: An old man commits suicide by jumping before a running train. In the next 72 hours, six stories unfold one after another. Curiously interlinked, each story is born out of a chance encounter between two strangers leading to a high voltage drama with a strange twist at the end.

metas.name: Ajob Premer Golpo
metas.description: A young boy, Dipto, falls in love with Sulagna who is much older than him. What happens next?

metas.name: Akashi Pullover
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Aloukik
metas.description: There are so many things happening in this world that have no explanation. Believe it or not, there is probably no one who doesn’t love ghost stories. There is a storyteller who would dictate his stories, while a girl would write it down. While writing those stories, the girl also gradually became haunted and then she was shocked. This series is about the surprises of the girl and the ghost stories told by the author.

metas.name: Aloukik Abhijaan
metas.description: When a parapsychologist discovers about a 10-year-old girl with supernatural powers, he decides to protect her from the greedy people who want to take advantage of her powers.

metas.name: Baazi
metas.description: Aditya, the son of a terminally ill businessman, discovers that his father has lost all his wealth to a swindler. Seeking revenge for this crime, he travels to London.

metas.name: Bastuhara
metas.description: The Homeless'reveals the journey of life of a bright yound boy who lost his family and childhood love during the East Pakistan riots but still managed to escape to india and fought all odds to reach the pinnacle of success.

metas.name: Bony
metas.description: An American-born Bangladeshi scientist with suspected links to terrorism is looking for a Bengali couple to discover an uncanny nature of activities in their newborn son. Will they successfully safeguard the life of their child?

metas.name: Dadur Kirti
metas.description: An overprotective grandfather doesn’t let his granddaughter date anyone. Things take a hilarious turn when she finds her Mr. Perfect, which leads to an amusing tussle between the two men.

metas.name: Dictionary
metas.description: Makar Kanti Chatterjee is a semi-educated self-made businessman who tries hard but often fails to communicate in English. On the other hand, his brother-in-law, Suman, gets romantically involved with a woman married to a reticent forest officer, Ashoke Sanyal. The screenplay is based on the story, Baba Hoya and Swami Hoya, by Buddhadeb Guha.

metas.name: Dostojee
metas.description: Two 8-year-old boys navigate a growing religious divide in this beautifully observed portrait of childhood set after the destruction of India’s Babri Mosque.

metas.name: Ei Ami Renu
metas.description: The movie Ei Ami Renu is mainly a story of the '80s, made in the context of the '80s. The story of the movie is reminiscent of the '80s. All the cultures of the '80s have been reflected in the movies. Ei Ami Renu's movie is based on the use of the old days the telephone, music, manners. Ei Ami Renu's story is based on the same novel, written by Samaresh Majumder.

metas.name: Ekannoborti
metas.description: Banerjee family is reunited for their household Durga Pujo but as the festivities ensue, the once empty and silent Banerjee home is filled with festive chaos.

metas.name: Ekti Bangali Alien Er Golpo
metas.description: A meek young man tortured by goons befriends an alien and becomes powerful and confident. He then uses his powers to bring the criminals to justice.

metas.name: F I R NO 339 07 06
metas.description: An upright but idiotic police officer arrives in Raghunathpur, Birbhum, West Bengal to investigate a murder and realises there is more to the crime than meets the eye.

metas.name: Golondaaj
metas.description: Based on true events,  Nagendra Prasad Sarbadhikari, "The Father of Indian Football", was the first Indian to play the sport and open a professional football club in the country.

metas.name: Habu Chandra Raja Gobu Chandra Montri
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Hiralal
metas.description: The Bengali-language biopic looks back on Hiralal Sen, who is credited with making India’s first advertising film and political documentary.

metas.name: Iskaboner Rani
metas.description: Laxmi grows up to become a scamster like her father Mahesh, who abandoned her in her childhood. When the police suspect the local Godman to be Mahesh, they take Laxmi's help to uncover his identity.

metas.name: Lockdown
metas.description: The film is based on Nigerian medical doctor Ameyo Adadevoh who was credited with having curbed a wider spread of the Ebola virus in Nigeria by placing the patient zero, Patrick Sawyer.

metas.name: Magic
metas.description: Based on the play 'Magic' by G.K Chesterton. A conjurer, feeling cornered by a hostile audience, turns an evening of simple parlor magic into a night of madness by performing one last trick. How does he do it? That is the grand question.

metas.name: Mukhosh
metas.description: Kingshuk, a consulting criminologist at the Kolkata Police, finds himself in a ghastly case of repeated murders with only one common link. As his investigation unfolds, Kingshuk encounters a series of grotesque killings and unexpected turn of events as he sets out to investigate the mysterious trail.

metas.name: Nirbandhamer Jora Khun
metas.description: When a double murder rocks the city, Shibani, a rookie female detective, arrives to investigate the case. Can Shibani uncover the mystery and find the killer?

metas.name: Pratidwandi
metas.description: A crisis management agency tries to solve a high profile kidnapping case while fighting with the law and their inner demons

metas.name: Pratighat
metas.description: Chandu, a gangster, comes to the rescue of Puja, a distressed girl, and they eventually fall in love. However, things take an unexpected turn when Chandu’s past comes back to haunt him.

metas.name: Prem Tame
metas.description: Prem Tame is Pablo's (Soumya Mukherjee) journey from giddying puppy love to falling in love with a puppy.

metas.name: Shorshephool
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: SOS Kolkata
metas.description: The movie is about a team of ATS officers fighting against terrorists in various situations. Danger comes when the terrorists attack in a Hotel.

metas.name: Tangra Blues
metas.description: a jubilant musical journey set against the backdrop of gang wars. Tangra Blues follows two people who go through various highs and lows of life, wrestling with the memories of the past and struggles of the present to create a foundation for a hopeful future.

metas.name: The Wanderlust of Apu
metas.description: With 'Avijatrik' (The Wanderlust of Apu) , by Subhrajit Mitra - the enduring and endearing character of 'Apu' is all set to return after 60 years. It is the sequel to the classic "Apu Trilogy", which were directed by Satyajit Ray.

metas.name: Tonic
metas.description: 75 years Jaladhar Sen and spouse Umarani plan for a foreign trip and come across Rhea and Tonic, the travel agents. The story shows how Tonic takes the couple to Darjeeling instead and becomes the best medicine.

metas.name: Tumi Ashbe Bole
metas.description: Desperate to get a good job, Nanda shifts to Kolkata where he falls in love with Aankhi. After a dramatic turn of events, Aankhi`s father gives his consent but Nanda doesn`t come for the wedding. Why did he change his decision to marry Aankhi?

metas.name: Unicorn
metas.description: In her escape, M. takes refuge in an abandoned house. Amidst the echoing sounds resulting from her efforts to make herself comfortable, she hears some footsteps outside and decides to open the door. A fortuitous visitor, who will become her companion-in-shelter, steps into the house.

metas.name: Aashiqui
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.description: A lawyer takes up the case of a young girl who has been sexually abused at school. She encounters a lot of resistance in her mission. Will she be able to bring the perpetrator to justice?

metas.name: Antony Kobial
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Asur
metas.description: Kigan, an artist, decides to create the world's largest Durga idol at Deshbandhu Park in South Kolkata. However, the enmity between friends and bruised egos threaten to destroy his mammoth endeavour.

metas.name: Binisutoy Without strings
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.description: The screenplay revolves around a couple who meet through social media and fall in love. What happens further is what the movie is all about.

metas.name: Bromhodoityo
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Cheeni
metas.description: Cheeni, a working girl, has to suddenly take care of her mother whose lifestyle turned bizarrely eccentric post-widowhood. Putting her hectic city-life on pause, Cheeni moves back with her mother who is suffering from brain cancer in their orthodox Manicktallah neighbourhood in Kolkata where chaotic fireworks ensue as the traditionalist housewife and her rebel millennial daughter battle amidst surprising revelations and family secrets.

metas.name: Detective
metas.description: Mahim spies on Manmoth, a freedom fighter. Manmoth in turn keeps a sharp eye on Mahim to reveal his secrets to his wife.

metas.name: Dharmajudhha
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Dracula Sir
metas.description: A small town school teacher with protruding canine teeth finds that he has striking similarities with the legendary Count Dracula.

metas.name: Dwitiyo Purush
metas.description: Dwitiyo Purush is a sequel of Baishe Srabon were Prosenjit Chatterjee dies at the end. In this film we will see Parambrata chattopadhyay as a police inspector who follows the path that Prasenjit Chatterjee showed him in Baishe Srabon to fight with criminals in various regions of kolkata.

metas.name: Ebhabei Golpo Hok
metas.description: Ebhabei Golpo Hok is a movie directed by Rohan Sen featuring Ananda Sankar Choudhury, Joy Sengupta.

metas.name: Gondi
metas.description: How friendship is meaningful in our life? Does it has any barrier by thought? Age, Color, race or religion? Let's make friendship universal -a circle free for better humanity.

metas.name: Grohon AKA Silence Of Love
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.description: A tale of three women who bond over loneliness and whose lives get intertwined as they deal with their hardships.

metas.name: Harano Prapti
metas.description: A young man is torn between his girlfriend and another woman who is a rape victim as he extends a helping hand to her and fights for justice.

metas.name: Hullor
metas.description: Based on the age-old concept of North and south Kolkata, Hullor is a comedy drama, that revolves around two couples and one shop. One from North Kolkata and another from South Kolkata. Add in an astrologer intent on cheating people and a devotee seeking to build a temple and the resulting melange will keep you in splits right till the end.

metas.name: Karma
metas.description: A story of a girl living with her mother in Kodi owning a guest house. Many guest came there. Now, see on ‘Addatimes’ how karma works.

metas.name: Lord of the Orphans
metas.description: Lord of the Orphans is the story of a family (The Palit Family) reeling under a hundred year old curse. It is a unique biopic, a sort of auto-biopic, where filmmaker Ranjan Palit turns the lens on himself and his family.

metas.name: Love Aaj Kal Porshu
metas.description: Two people whose love is a force that can never be changed, no matter how much its surroundings may change. A unique take on the timelessness of romance.

metas.name: Mainkar Chipay
metas.description: Three men are caught in a situation inside a car. One of them is a rich man who regularly sources cocaine from a fixed peddler at a fixed spot, another is a drug dealer who comes late and the third one is a cop. What happens next?

metas.name: Nilanjana
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Nirontor
metas.description: Travelling from the big city, Biplab Sen, a middle-aged civil engineer, and his young project assistant Bhaskar Mitra, have been assigned the responsibility of hunting a location for a new resort in an exotic, remote mountain range. With barely any phone network in the places they travel to, the two men with vastly different personalities develop a new-found friendship.

metas.name: Rawkto Rawhoshyo
metas.description: Swarnaja (Koel Mallick) is a hard-working do-gooder radio jockey with the rarest blood group in the world, Rh null blood group. She has been brought up by her grandmother. Her four year old son Pawrag is kidnapped by Shammo, an imposter.

metas.name: Saheber Cutlet
metas.description: Chef Ronojoy Ray Choudhury wants to sell his ancestral house in Chandannagore in West Bengal, go to Paris and open his own café but finds a refugee family squatting there instead! When they refuse to budge, Ronojoy must think of a way to get rid of them. Would he dump his longtime supportive girlfriend Vania in Kolkata? Fate has its ways.

metas.name: Shororipu 2 Jotugriho
metas.description: Deputy Commissioner of Police Sharma and his detective friend Chandrakant Sen are called on to investigate the death of veteran music director Debraj Sen. Was his death of Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome a mere accident? Did his third wife Megha Sen have anything to do with it?

metas.name: Sin Sister
metas.description: An author’s life changes completely after two sisters come to work for him. Is this a sinister war of love and identity?

metas.name: Sraboner Dhara
metas.description: The life of a renowned geriatrician, struggling with his personal problems, changes with the arrival of a patient with Alzheimer's disease and his wife.

metas.name: Sudakshinar Saree
metas.description: Sudakshina, a housewife, is constantly ridiculed by her family for her obsession with sarees. Her life changes after a chance encounter with Anirban, who pushes her to make a life-changing decision.

metas.name: Switzerland
metas.description: Cornered by a snooty in-law amid an awkward family lunch, a middle-class man makes a spur-of-the-moment decision to take his wife and two daughters to Switzerland for a vacation.

metas.name: Tasher Ghawr
metas.description: Sujata, a housewife of an upper-middle-class family stuck between the world that is around and within her. This is the story of her world her home and her search, for her "self". Will she be able to find what she is looking for?

metas.name: The Jungle Book
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: The Parcel
metas.description: A woman tries to uncover the mystery behind a series of mysterious packages from an anonymous sender that threaten her marriage.

metas.name: Tiki Taka
metas.description: Tiki-Taka is a ZEE5 Original sports comedy movie starring Parambrata Chattopadhyay, Emona Enabulu, and Ritabhari Chakraborty. The movie revolves around Khelechi, an African national, who comes to India with a football laden with narcotics to deliver it to P.K, who runs a drug cartel. However, in a comedy of errors P.K's men pick up the wrong guy, and Khelechi ends up with Raju, a con man.

metas.name: Tui Amar Hero
metas.description: Tui Amar Hero is a love story of two very contrasting characters – Biku and Piu.

metas.name: Urojahaj AKA The Flight
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Adda
metas.description: Two angels, Black and White, come down to Earth and spy in on the lives of a eclectic bunch of yuppies in order to decide humanity's fate.
